summary: Commit 2ea6d1f83 changes only the storage class of SsSeqCalledTbyT (static -> global) in src/main/psxsdk/libsnd/sscall.c and replaces the raw `.word 0x80083F6C` at 0x800A26D4 in asm/data/92E14.data.s with `.word SsSeqCalledTbyT`. The body is plain C with no register pins, __asm__, barriers, volatile, fabricated calls, or codegen-only constructs, so it needs no FAKE labels (items 2-3 clean). Dropping static is backed by PsyQ 4.0: SsSeqCalledTbyT is a LIBSND/SSCALL XDEF (docs/naming/libscan/anomalies.txt:4), so the global restores the original linkage. This also fixes an item-4-style defect, since the data word had been a raw address standing in for a symbol. No other definition or conflicting declaration exists in src, include or asm. ssstart.c's _SsSeqCalledTbyT_1per2 is a different symbol, and symbol_addrs.txt is documentation only. build/bb2.map resolves SsSeqCalledTbyT to 0x80083f6c, so the relocated word equals the old literal. build/bb2.exe (built 08:38, matching the commit) has SHA1 62efab4f73f992798c43e8c730aa43baa10bb4fa, equal to the oracle. layer2 hash in the ln-data worktree gives 6f59e4d4251652e7, as claimed. Hygiene debt: symbol_addrs.txt:232 still describes SsSeqCalledTbyT as 'static inside the SsStart splat extent', which is now stale.
